_about: Public-domain William John Knox Little (1839-1918, Anglo-Catholic preacher, Canon of Worcester) for the Word Hoard: 6 books from Internet Archive scans: Characteristics and Motives of the Christian Life (new and revised edition, 1881), The Mystery of the Passion (1881), The Hopes and Decisions of the Passion (1886), The Light of Life (1889), Sunlight and Shadow in the Christian Life (new edition, 1892) and Sacerdotalism (1894). Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
